title: America's Iron Giants - The World's Most Powerful Metalworkers
summary: Machine Thinking tells the story of the Cold War Heavy Press Program, the giant forging presses that make parts for aircraft, missiles and turbines.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an excellent introduction to massive forging presses, especially in threads about gigacasting and large manufacturing machines.

quote.text: I first learned about these presses several years ago from the YouTube channel Machine Thinking which is excellent and unfortunately infrequent.
